source_title: INDIA Bloc Plans Public Impeachment Of CEC Gyanesh Kumar; Rahul Gandhi To Deliver Closing Address - India Today - India Today
source_excerpt:
The opposition INDIA bloc has finalised plans to conduct a public impeachment of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar at Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge's residence. The event was shifted after venue permissions at Hotel Ashoka were denied due to police restrictions. Former Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar will preside over the proceedings, while Mallikarjun Kharge is set to move the notice of impeachment. Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi will deliver the concluding address, alongside presentations by civil society representatives and victims of the Special Intensive Revision process. Organisers clarified that the proceeding is a representative impeachment structured with parliamentary verticals rather than a mock parliament. Meanwhile, Rahul Gandhi released a video urging citizens to join the Chalo Delhi march on 1 November to protect the Constitution and democracy, even as local traders appealed for the demonstration's postponement due to the festive season. The Bharatiya Janata Party has countered the planned march with its own demonstrations across the capital. Read More

Spain Train Collision Kills 68; Rail Safety System Failure Alleged As Protests Demand This
A devastating high-speed rail collision in Spain has left 68 people dead and numerous passengers injured after a Renfe train collided with a stationary Iryo train on the Madrid-Andalusia line. A computer system failure reportedly disrupted railway safety across a 63-kilometre stretch, prompting manual control by state rail operator ADIF that allowed the train to proceed past a red signal. Violent protests erupted outside the Transport Ministry demanding Transport Minister Oscar Puente's resignation, met by police tear gas. Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez declared three days of national mourning and promised a full investigation into safety failures and potential negligence. Meanwhile, the Indian Embassy in Madrid urged affected citizens to reach out as rescue and recovery operations continued.
Indian-Origin Chef Reena Pushkarna Honours Captain Smith, Reveals Netanyahu’s Wife Requested This
Captain Smith Machar's bravery continues to receive recognition in Israel after he saved 179 people following a mid-air assault by his co-pilot on a Dubai to Tel Aviv flight. Indian-origin chef Reena Pushkarna prepared and distributed Kadha Prasad at her restaurant to honour the injured pilot as a gesture of gratitude. She also revealed that the Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's wife requested a special meal for the captain during his visit. Recently, visual evidence showed the severe extent of stitches and head injuries on the captain's scalp as he received a civilian honour in the UAE.
Naseeruddin Shah's 'Dimagi Naxal' Remark Row: Kiren Rijiju, Nitesh Rane & Puneet Issar Hit Out
A major political controversy erupted after veteran actor Naseeruddin Shah referred to himself as a proud 'dimagi Naxal' in a video message and challenged the government. Union Minister Kiren Rijiju criticised the actor, stating he once respected him but found his remarks dangerous and harmful to Indian democracy. Maharashtra politician Nitesh Rane accused Shah of promoting Pakistani propaganda and claimed the actor is often not in his senses. Actor Puneet Issar also condemned Shah, accusing him of selective silence on national issues and alleging support for anti-national groups. The broadcast further noted that Prime Minister Narendra Modi originally coined the term 'dimagi Naxal'.
Rahul Gandhi Accuses Govt of ‘Criminally Destroying’ Tata Group; BJP Hits Back Amid Leadership Row
A political war of words has broken out between Rahul Gandhi and the Bharatiya Janata Party over the escalating leadership dispute within the Tata Group. Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi accused the central government of criminally destroying Tata and questioned why discussions involving Tata Trusts and Tata Sons took place at Union Home Minister Amit Shah's residence. The BJP hit back, accusing Gandhi of making baseless, politically motivated statements without evidence. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman also challenged his remarks, stating that commercial and legal matters must not be casually labelled criminal and accused the Congress of historically stifling Indian enterprise. The confrontation unfolds amid a boardroom struggle at Tata Sons, where Tata Trusts Chairman Noel Tata challenged the resolution to reappoint N. Chandrasekaran as chairman, citing alleged procedural irregularities. Nationalist Congress Party leader Sharad Pawar also backed Noel Tata, urging the protection of the charitable ownership of the group.
